description: Draw one of these chart types and get an image link. Set type and data as below. rose (Nightingale/polar area), radial-bar: data [{category, value}]. lollipop: data [{category, value}]. dumbbell (before/after per row): data [{category, start, end}], optional startLabel, endLabel. slope (change between two points): data [{category, before, after}], optional beforeLabel, afterLabel. bubble: data [{x, y, size, label?, group?}], optional axisXTitle, axisYTitle. chord (flows between groups): data [{source, target, value}]. circle-packing: data [{name, value, group?}]. parallel-coordinates (compare items on several measures): data [{name, <measure>: number, ...}], at least two numeric measures. tree (hierarchy): data {name, children: [{name, children: [...]}]}. population-pyramid: data [{age, group, value}] with exactly two groups (e.g. Men, Women). marimekko (100% stacked with variable widths): data [{category, group, value}]. sunburst (hierarchy as rings), icicle (hierarchy as bands): data {name, children: [{name, value} or {name, children}]}; innermost items need a value. beeswarm (every value as a dot, no overlap): data [{value, group?, label?}], optional axisXTitle. density (smoothed distribution curves): data [{value, group?}], at least 3 values, optional axisXTitle. Use the dedicated generate_* tool for common types (line, column, pie, maps…). Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

afterLabel.description: slope: name of the right column, e.g. 'After'.

beforeLabel.description: slope: name of the left column, e.g. 'Before'.

brandTheme.description: Name of a brand theme saved on the user's account (their colours and footer), only when the user asks for their theme. Or "colorblind" for colours that people with colour-vision deficiency can tell apart (anyone can use it).

data.description: Rows (or a tree object for tree, sunburst and icicle) in the format listed for the type.

endLabel.description: dumbbell: name of the end value, e.g. '2025'.

startLabel.description: dumbbell: name of the start value, e.g. '2020'.

type.description: Which chart to draw; see the description for each type's data format.
